title: Fourth-moment-can't-beat-Johnson and the period 4th moment are the SAME no-go: any finite L^p moment chain returns the variance, so the escape must be L^infinity (max), the MGF/Chernoff kernel
reduced_to: The Johnson->capacity gap is an L-infinity (extreme-value) gap and NOT an L^p gap for any finite p: the per-coordinate matchCount profile m_i and the per-frequency period profile ||eta_b||^2 are BOTH L4/L2-flat, so every finite even-moment chain (Cauchy-Schwarz tower) returns only the variance scale Theta(n). The single open ingredient is therefore the per-period sub-Gaussian MGF (SalemZygmundChaining.SubGaussianMGF with sigma^2=O(n)), which feeds the axiom-clean maximal inequality chernoff_max_re_le to give B=max_c||eta_c|| <= C*sqrt(2 sigma^2 log m). That MGF input is NOT strictly weaker than the all-moments wall (it is the generating function of GaussianEnergyBound E_r(mu_n)<=(2r-1)!! n^r consumed at lambda* of effective order r~log m), so the open core welds back to BGK/Paley unchanged; what C046 genuinely delivers is the structural unification + correct identification that the admissible tool is L-infinity/MGF, not any L^p.
wall: W-BGK (the L-infinity escape route = the per-period sub-Gaussian MGF = the generating function of the all-even-moments GaussianEnergyBound = the Lam-Leung char-p / Bourgain-Glibichuk-Konyagin transfer wall; W-Johnson is the proven finite-moment floor that C046 correctly shows cannot be beaten by any finite L^p).
evidence: Two exact-arithmetic probes in scripts/probes/_407_conn/, prize regime ONLY (dyadic mu_n a PROPER subgroup, p=1 mod n prime, n<<sqrt q, beta=log_n(p) in [3.2,5.0], m=(p-1)/n up to 32769). (1) C046_kurtosis_nogo.py [n in {8,16,32,64}, p up to 1048609]: (a) EXACT identities Sum_b||eta_b||^2 = q*|G| verified rel.err = 0.00e+00 (the moments underpinning exists_period_sq_ge are exact); E(G)=q*Sum/q with E/n^2 in [2.63,2.95]. (b) PERIOD KURTOSIS E|eta|^4/(E|eta|^2)^2 over b!=0 = 2.62,2.62,2.81,2.81,2.90,2.91,2.95 -> approaches the real-Gaussian-flat value 3, BOUNDED and NOT exploding with m (stable across beta at fixed n: n=8 -> 2.619 at m=516 and 2.624 at m=4100) => the period family is L4/L2-flat, NO L4 localization of the max. (c) DECISIVE: the 4th-moment LOWER bound exists_period_sq_ge floor=(qE-n^4)/(qn-n^2) gives floor/n in [2.61,2.95] = exactly E(G)/n^2 = O(1) the VARIANCE scale, while the TRUE worst period B has B/sqrt(n log m) BOUNDED in [0.96,1.35] (sqrt(n log m) scale) and B/sqrt(floor) GROWING with m: 1.65,1.71,2.06,2.12,2.07,2.38,2.38. So true max = sqrt(n log m) >> L4-floor = sqrt(variance), the gap being exactly the log m=log((p-1)/n) extreme-value factor invisible to L4. (2) C046_metalemma_check.py + inline trimmed run [N in {8..128}, 20000 random nonneg profiles each]: the proposed meta-lemma finiteMoment_returns_variance holds at the algebra level for an arbitrary nonneg profile a_i -- the LIST no-go N*S4-S2^2 (=squaredJohnson_le_fourthChain direction) and the PERIOD floor max(a)-S4/S2 (=exists_period_sq_ge direction) are BOTH strictly >=0 (measured min over 20000 trials: +0.045 to +933 for list, +0.10 to +0.29 for floor) and BOTH ==0 exactly at the flat profile -- i.e. they are the SINGLE Cauchy-Schwarz S2^2<=N*S4 read in two directions (upper cap on the target sum vs lower bound on the max), confirming the unification; an extreme-value profile (flat sea + one bump of height sqrt(2 log N)) shows the L-infinity max exceeding the O(1) S4/S2 variance-floor by sqrt(log N) (N=128: floor 1.62 vs max 3.12), invisible to S4. The two cited in-tree theorems were READ and are sorry-free with asserted axiom audit [propext,Classical.choice,Quot.sound]: JohnsonFourthMomentNoGo.squaredJohnson_le_fourthChain (proves (n*S2)^2<=n^3*S4 always, the list no-go) and WorstPeriodLowerBound.exists_period_sq_ge (the period 4th-moment floor); SalemZygmundChaining.chernoff_max_re_le is the axiom-clean MGF maximal inequality (the named L-infinity escape). C046's unification of these is thus correct.
honest_note: PARTIAL, not a closure -- the honesty contract governs. WHAT IS PROVEN: (i) both no-gos are real, axiom-clean, in-tree, and genuinely the SAME single Cauchy-Schwarz S2^2<=N*S4 read in two directions (verified algebraically for arbitrary profiles and on the real Gauss sequence); (ii) the real period family IS L4/L2-flat at every tested proper dyadic subgroup (kurtosis bounded ->3, not exploding with m), so NO finite L^p moment can localize the worst period -- the escape above the variance/Johnson floor really is L-infinity; (iii) the true worst period is sqrt(n log m), strictly above the L4-floor sqrt(Theta(n)), the gap being the log m extreme-value factor. WHAT IS NOT SHOWN / THE WALL: the L-infinity escape that C046 correctly points to (the SubGaussianMGF feeding chernoff_max_re_le) is the SAME open object as the all-moments BGK/Paley wall, not a strictly cheaper tool -- by the standard MGF<->moments equivalence the sub-Gaussian MGF with sigma^2=O(n) is the generating function of GaussianEnergyBound E_r<=(2r-1)!! n^r and the maximal inequality consumes it at r~log m, requiring the high moments. (This repeats the decisive correction already logged for the closely related C006.) So C046 does NOT make progress on the open core; it is a correct STRUCTURAL UNIFICATION + LOCALIZATION (the admissible tool is L-infinity/MGF, every finite L^p is provably dead) that welds back to W-BGK. SCOPE: I did not run lake/build the oleans (no lock taken); axiom-cleanliness is asserted by the files' own #print axioms and verified by reading the sorry-free proofs. Probes use exact mod-p integer arithmetic for eta_b residues and double-precision complex exp for magnitudes (periods are sums of <=64 roots of unity, |eta|~sqrt q, double is ample at p<=1.05e6); m,p modest -- direct computation at the prize p~2^256, n=2^32 is infeasible, so 'period flat / MGF=O(n) at prize scale' remains EMPIRICAL exactly as SalemZygmundChaining.lean honestly states (needs Katz/Rojas-Leon Gauss-sum equidistribution, currently only qualitative). The kurtosis ->3 (real-flat) rather than ->2 (complex-flat): the connection's loose phrase 'kurtosis->3' matches the real-component normalization; either way the load-bearing fact (bounded, m-independent, no L4 localization) holds. No counterexample found -> not REFUTED; genuine proven pieces + sharpened open statement -> PARTIAL.
